scope: Current eight-page organizational guide, including complete zeta criterion, fourth-power finite tables, supplied tangent estimate, exact signed determinant and Selmer product; remaining construction hypotheses explicit.

previous_review.scope: The original seven-page review and its independent proof checks are preserved in this commit.

analytic_proof_preservation.scope: The complete short RH analytic section is byte-identical to recovered main.

checked: Signed prime-ramp coefficients for general character combinations
Prescribed tangent metric and retained flat-family/period hypotheses
Actual Selmer product, exceptional primes, no promise of strict gcd saving
Fixed-before-limit quantifiers and limits of quasi-RH/no-Siegel inputs

corrections: Explicitly signed convex ramps in the general-character explanation.
Explicit subpower condition on finite-table cost.
Common-divisor comparison may improve the bound; it need not improve it strictly.

visual_review.method: All eight pages rendered with pdftoppm -scale-to 1400, reviewed in readable four-page sheets.
visual_review.findings: Readable equations and references; no clipping, overlap or isolated reference-only page.

limits: This guide gives proved analytic implications and reductions, not a completed RH or GRH proof. No full Lean build or kernel replay.
